I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The date for the CRM is Monday, November 3, 2025.

The source is Moss's public Coastal digest of Sunday, 2025-11-02. It says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". It doesn't name Kwame as the new owner, so I told him to confirm the owner separately if the CRM needs it.

I also warned him that "PHL" is shorthand for Covey & Lark Retail (now Pellow Home Living) as well. He should make sure he updates the Pellucid Harbor record.
